scope: Prospective finite instrumentation experiment; preparation only. Current source phase attribution, not another old/new speedup or external quality certification.
inputs: Exact final-pipeline/configs/{case}.toml; strict NC<0.04 chips, caps400/400/100, cadence25/25/10,1worker,F32,Full. Do not change cap/cadence after observing measurements.

builds.targets: Fresh plain and instrumented targets on the measurement boot; CLI plus current_phase_codec example per copy. Same Rust1.97.0/locked/offline/release/target-cpu=native/jobs2. Existing hu_pipeline_probe only for postmeasurement correctness; retain its source/binary pins.

order.outer: Each case in fixed order, warmup then3 blocks; complete all48 solves before any codec or quality audit. No adaptive repetition. Then each case's measured block1 plain SOL becomes the immutable input for decode-all,read-root in that order, each with the same four-arm warmup/3block order. Save generation/write are already measured in each CLI solve; standalone stream-write is supported by the helper but not scheduled in this minimal campaign.
order.quality: After all measurements, audit all48 SOLs and checkpoints using retained current-source helpers. Canonical full/root/decode/rewrite verification on every codec invocation. No omitted warmup quality checks. Additional quality processes are bounded in the global deadline.

correctness: All48 live trajectories/stopping iterations/EV/BR/gains/NC and checkpoint/config/decoded strategy/value bytes match own case plain exactly; canonical excludes only original wall_secs. Quantized profile BR is recomputed on every solve artifact. All own-codec rewrite bytes equal immutable input. Compare same-source11e4062 proof02 where fields are machine independent; never require elapsed/path equality or old/new file equality. No quality success until all checks finish.

timing.policy: Each case/operation separately. Both fixed ratios must pass; sub10ms or failed calibration makes attribution not_evaluated/descriptive only. Retain every raw duration. No correction factors, subtraction-based inferred phases or replacement runs. Memory-arm durations never qualify as performance.
timing.measurement: CLI external wall and time-arm contiguous internal leaves; codec external wall for perturbation calibration plus native operation clocks. Warm input/hash prepass as frozen helper; no cold-cache claim. Observer/publishing gaps and startup/exit remain explicit.

memory.counter: Linux /proc/self/status VmHWM after clear_refs=5 at each phase boundary; raw start/end VmRSS and VmHWM retained. Absolute process-resident counter during instrumented phase, not incremental allocation or exact physical RSS.
memory.reset: Only memory arm writes5. Reset/read failure or inconsistent snapshot aborts. Never silently replace with sampling or cumulative high-water subtraction. Native wait4 after resets is not whole-process peak; use plain/off/time native child records for unreset whole-process peaks.
memory.generation: max(sol_preparation.end_hwm, sol_serialization_and_write.end_hwm), including solver state/payload live at these phases; checkpoint separately. Do not add peaks or subtract phase entry RSS. Read/full/root/rewrite counters include their resident inputs and exclude later canonical verification.
memory.calibration: Before samples, compile/run memory_probe.c under finite supervisor. Touch/unmap128MiB prior history, reset, touch1MiB/reset, touch64MiB/reset; require recorded highwater collapse after unmap, low phase<=postreset baseline+8MiB, large phase>=baseline+48MiB, measured64MiB peak-minus1MiB peak>=32MiB. Preserve all snapshots. Fresh native launcher calibration from focused-memory required when using wait4 whole-process counters.
memory.observer_screen: Retain max3 of memory-arm largest leaf peak and all unreset plain/off/time native child peaks; report counter/observer differences, not a physical bound. If memory-arm max exceeds max plain native peak by more than max(1MiB,5%), mark phase memory attribution ineligible. Passing permits descriptive instrumented counter reporting only, never old/new resource adoption.

limits.planned_machine: 4-vCPU16GiB x86_64 Spot,40GiB auto-delete disk; one boot, no32-vCPU resize

stop: Require each next stage's full timeout+20s to fit the absolute work deadline. First error,preemption,hash/boot/CPU/source/containment change,resource breach,deadline,memory reset calibration failure or missing raw is terminal. Perturbation screens are computed only after complete data and can be not_evaluated without hiding records. Retain completed/failed/skipped counts and partial evidence; no retry,threshold change or continued campaign on new boot. Outer systemd KillMode=control-group,SendSIGKILL=yes,CPUWeight100,MemoryMax12GiB,MemorySwapMax0,RuntimeMax capped by deadline; VM STOP fixed before launch and cleanup after verified recovery.
freeze: Before builds: every source input and generated output,prepare/runtime/protocol/validator/native probe/supervisor,all3 configs,compiler/Cargo flags/environment. Before samples: two CLI/two codec binary hashes,helper/native binary hashes,source/build logs,OS/CPU/features/boot,actual cgroup limits,absolute deadlines,resource/budget record. Before/after stage identity checks. Archive retains original bytes/paths/hashes, not merely report summaries.
required_before_execution: Independent generated-Rust/source review and source-pinned two-copy builds; Python tests alone do not validate Rust.
Owner creates current pricing/resource plan within remaining2USD, freezes one-hour absolute STOP and900s recovery reserve; no launch is performed by these files.
Implement/review a finite runner/portable retained checker that enforces this protocol. Existing final-pipeline controls stay frozen; this preparation does not yet provide that orchestration.
No concurrent builds/transfers/archiving/other experiments during measured blocks. New output paths only, copy source remains immutable after its manifest.
